old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a compass on a plain white surface. The compass is metallic and has two legs with fine tips at the ends. One leg is positioned on the paper, while the other leg is raised. A faint, incomplete circle is visible on the paper, suggesting a prior or ongoing drawing action. The camera maintains a close view with slight shifts, focusing on the compass and the paper. There are no other objects or characters present in the frame, and the background remains consistently white, emphasizing the simplicity of the scene.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a compass in action on a plain white surface. The compass is metallic and has two legs with sharp points at the ends. Initially, one leg of the compass is positioned on the paper, while the other leg is raised. As the video progresses, the leg that was initially raised begins to rotate around its point, drawing a smooth arc on the paper. This arc gradually forms a complete circle. The camera remains steady throughout, focusing closely on the compass and the paper, ensuring that the viewer can clearly see the precision and smoothness of the circle being drawn. There are no other objects or characters present in the frame, and the background remains consistently white, emphasizing the simplicity and clarity of the drawing process.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a metal drafting compass on a white sheet of paper that already bears a faint thin arc across its lower part. Two legs joined off the top of the frame are visible: one leg's tip stays near the middle, while the other sweeps around it. The sweeping leg is seen at the right edge, moves left across the top, then continues along the left side. As it descends, its lower end resolves into a knurled holder capped with a dark lead point. That point travels along the faint arc from the left side of the curve toward the bottom-center. Pronounced motion blur on the moving leg marks a continuous sweep, and the other leg remains roughly in place. The arc remains a steady thin line in roughly the same place.
